# `silk/build/request`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Complete compilation inputs for the compiler and development tools.

## When to use
Use `Request` to describe one compilation independently of a package manifest or task program.
Read and write it with `silk.schema.toml.SchemaToml` or `silk.schema.json.SchemaJson`.
Generate its JSON Schema with `silk.schema.json_schema.JsonSchemas`.

## Details
All filesystem paths are absolute. Packages and their import edges are explicit.
Compilation requests contain resolved values and never execute a task or fetch a dependency.
Every record rejects unknown fields. The `version` field identifies this wire format.

Import as `Request` with `import silk.build.request { Request }`.

Public declarations: 26.
